name: PandaX
summary: A xenon-detector programme at the China Jinping Underground Laboratory, led by Shanghai Jiao Tong University, studying dark matter, neutrinos and rare decays. Distinguish data-taking phases I, II and 4T from next-generation xT; the gaseous-xenon double-beta detector PandaX-III is not a liquid-xenon dark-matter phase.
detection_principle: Dual-phase liquid-xenon TPCs combine scintillation and ionization to reconstruct interaction positions and recoil types. Electron-recoil spectra also support searches such as bosonic-dark-matter absorption.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
